findings.subject: src/pilot/pilot_a.c:16-19 (func_00140dac)
findings.summary: The header models its indexed tail as E140dac e[1], yet func_00140dac indexes it with an unconstrained int. The byte match and 0xc stride are established, but standard C only permits reading element 0 of this declared array. The sole direct original caller forwards its own argument_2; a zero-only precondition has not been recovered. [INFERENCE] This may be an old one-element trailing-array idiom, not a demonstrated runtime defect. Concrete repair: retain an explicit source-language/index-domain qualification in the checkpoint known-issues record; for a successor source revision, recover the real bound or use a supported flexible-tail representation, then re-prepare/re-match rather than mutate this prepared checkpoint.
findings.repair: Document this qualification before finalizing; change the source only in a newly prepared checkpoint using an evidence-backed bound or compiler-supported flexible tail.
